messages.content: Extract final barrier state only. Do not judge story validity. Return JSON only.

garage door

The garage door buckles inward, broken but still partly hanging in the frame.

LOCKED includes locked, sealed, barred, or bolted. CLOSED means shut/closed without an established lock. OPEN means open/passable through that barrier. BROKEN means damaged/breached but the barrier still physically exists. DESTROYED means the barrier is gone or no longer functions as a barrier. UNSPECIFIED means RAW SCENE does not establish enough information. Do not decide whether the scene is valid. Return JSON: {"status":"..."}
